welcome.title: Welcome to Open Setlist!
welcome.body: Open Setlist is a free, open-source setlist manager that runs entirely in your browser. Your data stays on your device — no account needed.

import.title: Bring Your Songs
import.body: Coming from Setlist Helper? Import your catalog and setlist CSVs on the Sync page. In the song editor, "Paste chart" turns a chart copied from a website or PDF into ChordPro. Create your own profile in Settings first to keep the demo songs apart.

stage.title: On Stage
stage.body: In performance mode, ⋮ → My part shows only your instrument's sections: singers can hide chords, B♭/E♭/F horns read their written pitch. Need paper? Print a stage sheet or a chart booklet from any setlist.

sync.title: Sync with Your Band
sync.body: Connect GitHub or Google Drive in Settings, then send your bandmates an invite link. Incoming changes are shown for review before they apply.

install.title: Install the App
install.body: Open Setlist works offline as a PWA. On mobile, use your browser's "Add to Home Screen" option. On desktop, look for the install icon in the address bar.

about.heading: About
about.body:
Open Setlist is a free, open-source setlist manager that runs entirely in your browser.

Your songs and setlists are stored locally on your device. No account is required.

Use profiles to separate different projects or bands. Each profile has its own data and sync configuration.

Connect GitHub or Google Drive in Settings to back up and sync across devices. Share your Google Drive file with bandmates to collaborate.

The app works offline as a PWA — use your browser's "Add to Home Screen" to install it.
about.resetMessage: This will delete all local data — profiles, songs, setlists, and preferences. Remote storage (GitHub, Google Drive) will not be affected.
